physical_conditions.note: Fresh-header payload replay of a 1-packet stale safe segment. Sequence and timestamp advance normally and the HMAC is recomputed, so every packet is ACCEPTED. Cyber-valid, physically stale.

integrity.note: Carrier packets carry their original valid HMAC. A2.3 forged packets carry a freshly computed valid HMAC over the replayed payload (models the IP-F compromised node). Every row verifies under host_receiver logic.

known_limitations: Carrier sensor values are the firmware rand() stub. A2.3 defeats every crypto and freshness check, so at the packet layer the replayed rows are indistinguishable from clean by construction: recall at the communication layer is zero. Separating them requires physical plausibility against the concurrent load condition, which needs the real sensor channels (deferred until sensor integration).

deviation_abs and ground_truth_value are the temperature difference from the true concurrent carrier value; humidity is replayed in the same rows. These are provided for later twin scoring, not as a packet-layer discriminator.
receiver_detection_result is the receiver verdict, carried as a feature, never the label.
